description: This file defines an Android activity class for configuring an analog watch face in a wearable device. It extends Activity, sets up the user interface, and displays the watch face component name.

classes.name: AnalogAndCardBoundsWatchFaceConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android activity responsible for configuring the watch face, displaying its class name in the UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and updates the label with the watch face class name.
